trigger_record.summary: Provider replaced the underlying model version without advance notice. A correspondent bank reported duplicated repair instructions on three payments before internal monitoring flagged the change.

delta_description.summary: Vendor rolled the served model to a new version. Tool-call formatting changed subtly, causing the agent to re-issue a repair action when the first call returned an ambiguous acknowledgement, rather than treating it as terminal.

change_records.reference: Provider release note 2026.07.1, no advance notification
No internal change; orchestration logic unchanged since ORCH-88

reliability_impact_analysis.assessment: The agent holds delegated authority to issue payment repair instructions without human confirmation. Duplicate instructions created three double-repair events requiring manual recall, with correspondent bank exposure. Section 8 notes agentic systems can fail across a chain of actions rather than a single output, and section 4 treats autonomy as a threshold multiplier: the same defect in an advisory tool would be recoverable, but here it produced unreviewed external actions.
reliability_impact_analysis.root_cause: Vendor model version change altered tool-call acknowledgement semantics. The agent's retry guard tested for an exact acknowledgement string that the new version no longer emitted, so the terminal state was never recognised.

drift_indicators: tool-call retry count per workflow up from 1.01 to 1.34
unrecognised acknowledgement payloads present from 02:00 onward
monitoring_snapshot.notes: Override rate is zero by design: this workflow has no human confirmation step, which is precisely why the defect reached external counterparties.

decision_record.rationale: An autonomous system with payment-instruction authority operated outside its accepted operating envelope and produced external financial actions that required recall. The accepted envelope assumed a pinned model version; that assumption no longer holds. Autonomous execution is suspended and the workflow reverts to the human-confirmation fallback path pending revalidation against the new model version and reopened approval conditions.
temporary_controls: Autonomous execution suspended; all repair instructions routed to payment operations for confirmation
Model version pinned in the serving contract with change notification required
Retry guard rewritten to treat unrecognised acknowledgements as non-terminal and halt
Daily reconciliation against correspondent bank confirmations
